title: Love this habit tracker 💕
body: I use it for habit tracking since it gives so many habits for free. I love love this app. Its gives a weekly, monthly and yearly stat all in the free version. It has widgets and is compatible with Apple Watch. So underrated ♥️
author: riyyay

title: Praise and a feature request
body:
Love the app! Kudos to the developer for making such a clean, aesthetic and effective habit tracker.
I am a free user and the ads are a bit annoying but I am making do with that. I have a feature request: if we could track habits that need to be logged multiple times a day, such as drinking 2 litres of water, that would make the app more powerful. Thanks.
author: zebak12
